## Activity

During July 2021, Market Eye Clinic completed 334 captures. Activity was recorded for the month as planned, with session lists operating routinely apart from scheduled leave. The volume of captures indicates that the clinic continued to provide imaging services throughout the reporting period. No operational issue was reported that affected the completion of the planned sessions.

## Image quality

There were 17 ungradable captures. This represents an ungradable rate of 5.1 per cent. The image quality result should be monitored through routine review, with attention given to any recurring factors that may affect image acquisition or assessment. Further local action can be considered if the rate changes in subsequent reporting periods.

## Grading

A total of 60 results were graded referable. The median grading lag was 1 day. Grading activity therefore continued alongside image capture, with results assessed within the reported timeframe. The referable results should continue through the established clinical follow-up pathway, in line with routine service arrangements. Overall, the report records completed activity, a defined level of ungradable images, and ongoing grading of captured images.
